summary: Comprehensive testing of Launch Offer UI on Pricing Page and Subscription Analytics Dashboard. All features working correctly. Pricing page shows LAUNCH50 banner, LAUNCH SPECIAL badges with discount percentages (50% OFF on Premium, 70% OFF on VIP), strikethrough prices for price anchoring, and savings messages. Admin Subscription Analytics dashboard fully functional with revenue metrics, plan distribution, revenue trend chart, and coupon performance section.

issues: Buyer Fee Discount and Seller Fee Discount badges may be cut off at bottom of card - consider adding more padding or scrollable area. Labels are visible but percentage badges (30%, 37.5% for Premium, 40%, 50% for VIP) may not be fully visible without scrolling within the card.

critical_code_review_comments: SubscriptionPricingPage.js correctly implements Launch Offer UI with LAUNCH50 banner and LAUNCH SPECIAL badges
Strikethrough prices use FULL_PRICES constant for price anchoring ($599.99 -> $299.99 for Premium yearly, $1,999.99 -> $599 for VIP yearly)
Savings badges correctly calculate and display discount amounts (Save $300 for Premium, Save $1,400.99 for VIP)
SubscriptionAnalytics.js properly fetches and displays subscription analytics from /api/admin/subscription-analytics
Revenue overview cards (Total Revenue, This Month, MRR, Active Subscribers) all render correctly
Plan Distribution shows Free/Premium/VIP breakdown with visual progress bars
Revenue Trend chart displays 6 months of data with billing period split
Coupon Performance section shows total coupons, active count, uses, discounts given, and top performing coupons list
seed_data_creation: None - used existing LAUNCH50 and LAUNCH20 coupons
context_for_next_testing_agent: Subscription pricing and analytics systems fully functional. LAUNCH50 coupon (50% off) is the main promo code displayed in the banner. Admin Subscription Analytics accessible under Admin Panel > Settings > Subscription Analytics tab. Plan distribution shows 18 Free, 0 Premium, 1 VIP user.
